snippet.title: HOTEL BARCELONA - Dr Carnival Trailer 2025 | A new game from SWERY & Suda51
snippet.description:
Out Now. We hope you enjoy your stay. 
PC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2286600/HOTEL_BARCELONA/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_campaign=OutNow
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/hotel-barcelona/9p9gmchf2jjs
Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-dk/concept/10010271

From legendary Japanese creators SWERY (Deadly Premonition, D4: Dark Dreams Don't Die) and SUDA51 (No More Heroes, Lollipop Chainsaw), welcome to HOTEL BARCELONA - a surreal, blood-soaked sidescrolling roguelite. Trapped in a horror hotel built on good times and bad vibes, you must fight, die, repeat, and maybe - just maybe - uncover the truth behind the Seven Slasher Killers who roam the grounds.

A rookie marshal - possessed by a psychopath.
The most dangerous killers in America - under one roof.
CHECK IN. WIPE ‘EM OUT.

Follow CULT Games
